skipped.name: battery_self_reported_triggers_record_confirmation
skipped.reason: 0/10 at N=10 on v0.51+v0.22 even with the Example 19 battery arc. Two causes: (1) cold-morning slow-crank is a softer elimination-test contradiction than squeal-after-new-pads (a plausible innocent cold-weather reading exists), so the model explains or narrows instead of gating; (2) one rep DID fire the card but failed the per-turn get_vehicle_health assertion because the read happened a turn earlier — the tools_called_across_turns runner primitive (Sprint 3 carryover) is needed to assert this case fairly. Re-enable after the polite-exit turn-3 termination follow-up + the cross-turn primitive. The brake gate case carries the elimination-test coverage meanwhile (~65-80%).
